capabilities: Display a note or arbitrary text in an auto-scrolling teleprompter window
Adjust speed, font, spacing, padding, colors, and countdown delay
Mirror text horizontally or vertically for teleprompter rigs
Detach the teleprompter to a separate window or open it full-screen
Control the teleprompter via 85 hotkey commands, an API, and a URI handler
extras: The README discloses a single static ad (a link to the author's own project) on the plugin's About settings page. The detach-window and opacity features are not available on mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a note in a large, steadily auto-scrolling view for reading aloud while presenting or recording.
summary: Teleprompter window that shows the current note as large auto-scrolling text for reading during presentations or video recording.
